game_concept: A arcade set in Mystic Forest – Moonlit Clearing, a moonlit clearing: the druid must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Moonlit Clearing: a moonlit clearing
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Expression statements: build a valid C source file that prints 29. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the router at (2, 3), with the upper processing path on row 1 and lower path on row 6. IF item value is even, send north to the upper branch; ELSE send south to the lower branch. Merge the two plate streams at (8, 3), then use the shared assembler and output. Deliver exactly 14 components (7 upper, 7 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 14.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Off By One Fixer' (Week 5 slot 13), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Moonlit Clearing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization
